summary_1line: Sarama comforts Sita, secretly spies on Ravana’s council, and reports that he refuses to release her despite warnings from his advisers.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sarama gently wipes Sita’s tears in the Ashoka Grove as the sorrowful princess sits surrounded by grim titan guards.
Sarama slips invisibly through the air above Lanka to secretly listen to Ravana and his ministers in council.
Sita eagerly embraces the returning Sarama in the moonlit Ashoka Grove, desperate to hear Ravana’s decision.
